newsitem.title: OMAN: Omani real estate investment up in first 9 mths.
newsitem.headline: Omani real estate investment up in first 9 mths.

text.p: Omanis invested 159 million rials ($418 million) in real estate in the first nine months of 1996 compared with 128 million rials during the same period last year, a local newspaper said on Wednesday.
The Arabic-language newspaper Oman, quoting a housing ministry official, said credit facilities offered by banks helped increase real estate activity in 1996.
A construction boom in recent years has driven rents in the capital Muscat sharply lower with many buildings unoccupied.
The housing index of the Muscat consumer price index fell 1.8 percent in the first seven months of this year, reflecting the lower rents.
